description: Patients in our village cannot get essential medicines from the local health centre
Children in the village have no proper school building or classroom facilities
Farmers are losing crops because irrigation facilities are not available
Residents have to walk several kilometres to get safe drinking water
Garbage is being dumped openly near houses and is not collected regularly
The village road becomes badly damaged and difficult to use during the rainy season
There are frequent power cuts and unreliable electricity supply in the village
Women and children in the village cannot get proper medical care from the local health centre
Young people cannot find local employment opportunities after completing their education
The village lacks proper internet connectivity and residents cannot access online government services
